title: How to get a tech job without a CS degree using AI

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Did you know 75% of tech jobs don’t require a CS degree?

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: AI is changing the hiring game faster than you think.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: You can now use AI to build coding skills and portfolios in weeks.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Tools like GitHub Copilot and Codeium help you write real code.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Freelancers and career changers are getting hired without degrees.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The key is showing what you can do, not just what you studied.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Ready to learn how? Tap to see the tools I use every day.
